security_summary: Zero secrets committed to version control. Client boundary strictly enforced: only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is exposed to client-side frontend code.

variable_catalog.name: SECRET_KEY
variable_catalog.purpose: Application security signing and hashing key

variable_catalog.name: SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variable_catalog.purpose: Fernet primary key for BYOK provider credential encryption

variable_catalog.name: PREVIOUS_SECRET_KEYS
variable_catalog.purpose: Comma-separated list of previous Fernet keys for zero-downtime rotation fallback

variable_catalog.name: DATABASE_SYNC_URL
variable_catalog.purpose: Synchronous PostgreSQL connection URI (psycopg2) for Alembic migrations

variable_catalog.name: STORAGE_PATH
variable_catalog.purpose: Local directory path for file uploads

variable_catalog.name: CORS_ORIGINS
variable_catalog.purpose: Allowed frontend origins; supports regex for Vercel preview URLs

variable_catalog.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
variable_catalog.purpose: Public URL of the backend API used by browser fetch calls
